description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Disruptive Pitmage, adding {U}.
When Disruptive Pitmage dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Disruptive Pitmage from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Disruptive Pitmage's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.
